text: もりは　てんねんの　めいろよ　まよわないよう　きを　つけて

structure.jp: もりは　てんねんの　めいろよ
structure.en: the forest is a natural maze
so that you don't get lost

patterns.name: 〜ないように
patterns.explanation: ないよう(に) after a verb says what you are trying to keep from happening. まよわないよう = 'so that you don't get lost'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a friendly request, short for てください. きを　つけて = 'be careful'.
